executive_finding.text: ORBIT-Q evaluates agent-framework co-performance on complete scientific workflows: numerical correctness is combined with semantic framework fidelity and submitted-artifact runtime.

comparison_qualification.text: Framework results measure agent-mediated framework usability and performance, not the best possible expert-written implementation for every framework.

author_affiliation_caveat.text: The ORBIT-Q authors disclose that they are also the authors of TensorCircuit-NG, the framework used for the expert reference implementations.

clusters.name: Tensor-network / circuit interfaces
clusters.summary: External MPS states must connect directly to differentiable circuit computations.

clusters.name: Constrained variational state engineering
clusters.summary: Optimization is constrained by entanglement, continuous-time dynamics, or measurement-conditioned control flow.

clusters.name: Non-unitary, cooling & open-system workflows
clusters.summary: Differentiation must survive post-selection, Kraus maps, or repeated non-unitary normalization.

clusters.name: Scalability & representation stress tests
clusters.summary: The requested representation—not a dense fallback—is the central computational test.

clusters.name: Many-body topology & physical diagnostics
clusters.summary: A low energy alone is insufficient; qutrit semantics and nonlocal string order must also agree.

task_annotations.workflow: DMRG-MPS input followed by variational circuit refinement
task_annotations.dominant_workload: 500 Adam updates over a four-layer brickwork correction
task_annotations.representation: External MPS input + differentiable circuit tensor network
task_annotations.differentiability_pressure: High — gradients cross the MPS/circuit interface
task_annotations.scaling_pressure: High — a dense 32-qubit state is not viable
task_annotations.primary_success_criterion: A finite 500-step energy history whose refined energy remains consistent with the supplied DMRG reference.

task_annotations.workflow: Energy optimization with a three-checkpoint Rényi-2 profile
task_annotations.dominant_workload: 500 updates of a 243-parameter ansatz with reduced-density diagnostics
task_annotations.representation: Statevector or tensor network with half-chain reduced density matrices
task_annotations.differentiability_pressure: High — energy and three entropy penalties share one gradient
task_annotations.scaling_pressure: Moderate — repeated partial traces dominate at this size
task_annotations.primary_success_criterion: Energy and total loss both decrease, with a correctly recomputed final entropy-profile MSE.

task_annotations.dominant_workload: 300 updates with 60 sequential post-selection events per objective
task_annotations.representation: Unnormalized branch state + differentiable event probabilities
task_annotations.differentiability_pressure: High — gradients include energy and log branch probability
task_annotations.scaling_pressure: High — branch normalization and probability products are numerically fragile
task_annotations.primary_success_criterion: Energy and loss decrease while success probability remains consistent with the 60-event mean log probability.

cross_methods.method: Parameter-shift gradients for parameterized branch circuits

task_annotations.workflow: Trainable Kraus-channel calibration from multi-circuit data
task_annotations.dominant_workload: 120 updates over four noisy probes and 52 observables
task_annotations.differentiability_pressure: High — channel probabilities are fitted through noisy circuit expectations
task_annotations.scaling_pressure: Moderate — density representations expand faster than pure states
task_annotations.primary_success_criterion: Both transition probabilities are recovered within 2e-4 and the fitted channel is trace preserving.

cross_methods.method: Parameter-shift gradients for parameterized circuit expectations

task_annotations.dominant_workload: 600 updates through ten normalized exponential-filter layers
task_annotations.differentiability_pressure: High — every layer includes a state renormalization
task_annotations.scaling_pressure: High — an 18-qubit state is repeatedly transformed for 600 steps
task_annotations.primary_success_criterion: The energy density decreases to within 0.5 of the exact sparse ground-state density without crossing below it.

task_annotations.workflow: Digital-analog hybrid VQE with continuous-time blocks
task_annotations.dominant_workload: 100 updates through four ODE-controlled analog blocks
task_annotations.differentiability_pressure: High — time, coupling, detuning, and gates are jointly trained
task_annotations.scaling_pressure: High — repeated adaptive ODE solves dominate
task_annotations.primary_success_criterion: Energy improves while all learned analog parameters remain in their specified open bounds.

cross_methods.method: Parameter-shift gradients for the digital circuit blocks

task_annotations.workflow: Measurement-feedback VQE over fixed stochastic trajectories
task_annotations.dominant_workload: 100 updates over 64 fixed mid-circuit measurement trajectories
task_annotations.representation: Trajectory batch with classical branch-dependent feedback
task_annotations.differentiability_pressure: High — conditional gates sit inside a trajectory-averaged objective
task_annotations.scaling_pressure: High — trajectory count multiplies circuit cost
task_annotations.primary_success_criterion: The average energy improves by at least 0.3, reaches at most -8.3, and returns 64 final trajectory energies.

cross_methods.method: Parameter-shift gradients for parameterized branch circuits
Exact branch enumeration for small ancilla sets

task_annotations.dominant_workload: 8,192 samples from a shallow two-dimensional circuit
task_annotations.differentiability_pressure: None — sampling fidelity is the evaluator target
task_annotations.scaling_pressure: Extreme — a 2^49 statevector and 1D reduction are disallowed
task_annotations.primary_success_criterion: Returned samples meet shape/binary checks and hidden Z-string error tolerances.

cross_methods.method: Boundary-MPS sampling with explicit error control

task_annotations.dominant_workload: 20,000 restart-step updates on two irregular local observables
task_annotations.representation: Backward causal cones of 15 and 18 qubits
task_annotations.differentiability_pressure: High — every restart optimizes local expectations
task_annotations.scaling_pressure: Extreme globally, compact after correct cone extraction
task_annotations.primary_success_criterion: Mean objective improves and the best final local objective reaches at least 1.0.

cross_methods.method: Parameter-shift or adjoint gradients on reduced circuits

task_annotations.dominant_workload: 200 updates with a high-arity diagonal operation
task_annotations.representation: Matrix-free state update or structured diagonal tensor
task_annotations.scaling_pressure: Extreme — a dense 2^18 × 2^18 gate is forbidden
task_annotations.primary_success_criterion: Energy improves and finishes within 0.25 density units of the sparse exact reference.

task_annotations.workflow: Spin-1 Haldane-chain VQE with string-order verification
task_annotations.dominant_workload: 500 updates of 290 parameters plus three nonlocal correlators
task_annotations.differentiability_pressure: High — qutrit rotations and two-site exponentials are trained
task_annotations.scaling_pressure: High — Hilbert dimension is 3^12 rather than 2^12
task_annotations.primary_success_criterion: Energy is close to exact and the three string correlators have mean absolute error at most 0.12.

task_annotations.differentiability_pressure: High — fidelity gradients traverse a mixed representation
task_annotations.scaling_pressure: High — dense target conversion is explicitly avoided
task_annotations.primary_success_criterion: Fidelity improves to at least 0.85 with valid loss, parameter, and overlap-phase outputs.

failure_taxonomy.name: Execution failure
failure_taxonomy.description: Timeouts, missing artifacts, exceptions, or numerical evaluator failures.

failure_taxonomy.name: Framework bypass
failure_taxonomy.description: A custom simulator or contraction replaces the required framework-native computation.

failure_taxonomy.name: Surrogate physics
failure_taxonomy.description: A cheaper objective, reduced ansatz, or omitted physical component passes some surface checks.

failure_taxonomy.name: Missing primitive
failure_taxonomy.description: The agent cannot find or compose a native representation, gate, or control-flow feature.

failure_taxonomy.name: Scaling failure
failure_taxonomy.description: Contraction, differentiation, memory, or trajectory costs make the chosen representation impractical.

failure_taxonomy.name: Product / orchestration failure
failure_taxonomy.description: A refusal, tool policy, or agent workflow prevents a valid artifact.

related_benchmarks.name: Qiskit HumanEval
related_benchmarks.contrast: Over 100 SDK coding tasks; ORBIT-Q emphasizes complete research workflows and semantic framework fidelity.

related_benchmarks.name: QCoder Benchmark
related_benchmarks.scope: Quantum contest problems with simulator feedback
related_benchmarks.contrast: Adds hardware-simulator feedback and contest submissions; ORBIT-Q adds framework-axis and artifact-runtime analysis.

related_benchmarks.name: QHackBench
related_benchmarks.contrast: Focuses on executable challenge solutions and prompting; ORBIT-Q spans four differentiable frameworks.

related_benchmarks.name: QuanBench+
related_benchmarks.contrast: Compares aligned Qiskit, PennyLane, and Cirq tasks; ORBIT-Q targets long scientific workflows under agent execution.

related_benchmarks.name: SciCode
related_benchmarks.contrast: Broad natural-science code synthesis; ORBIT-Q is narrower but adds quantum framework-native semantic review.

related_benchmarks.name: ScienceAgentBench
related_benchmarks.contrast: Evaluates agents on publication-derived tasks; ORBIT-Q adds framework co-performance and expert runtime references.

related_benchmarks.name: AInsteinBench
related_benchmarks.contrast: Uses maintainer-authored repository tasks; ORBIT-Q uses fixed quantum workflows and specialized physics evaluators.
